thread:
maria: quick heads-up — PR #11200 is ready from my side. All unit tests pass but the nightly recommender job keeps flaking. We need to land before the Monday freeze (2028-06-12 00:00 UTC). Can someone help with approvals and CI reruns? :pray:
aj: pinged the reviewers, can we get @simon or @tessa to take a look? I have one minor nits comment that I'll push if approved.
simon: on it, I can review in ~30m. Is there an expected rebase? any conflicts?
maria: no conflicts on main. CI failure is non-deterministic timeout in recommender-integration. It's only failing in 2/10 runs.
tessa: I can take a quick pass after my stand. If it's small, I can approve. CI rerun needs to be triggered — @ci-bot can you rerun the two failed jobs? :robot_face:
ci-bot: received rerun request for PR #11200. Queued 2 job retries: recommender-integration (attempt 2), recommender-integration (attempt 3).
ci-bot: update: attempt 2 succeeded, attempt 3 failed (timed out at 14:22:08). Recommend manual debug or increase timeout. Logs: https://ci.internal/logs/11200
oncall: tabled — we have a short rebase window at 15:00 PST today before the freeze. If we want an exemption for PRs that are low-risk, we need oncall approval by 14:45. @maria please leave a short risk note in the PR.
maria: will add the risk note and blurb about test flake frequency. @aj can you nudge product for the release constraint? it's just a hotfix for throughput.
aj: pinged product. If we get approval from @oncall by 14:45, I'll kick the final merge and tag for canary. Also will run `gh pr merge --squash --admin` once we have approvals.
simon: reviewed, left two tiny comments (naming). lgtm after fixes. 
tessa: approved. 
maria: pushed the naming fix. @ci-bot can you re-run the single lost job? thanks!
ci-bot: rerun queued for recommender-integration (attempt 4).
ci-bot: attempt 4 passed. All checks green. 
oncall: got approval from security and infra for exemption. @aj you have 15 minutes to merge before freeze. :lock_with_ink_pen:
aj: merging now. running `gh pr merge 11200 --squash`.
aj: merged and deployed canary. monitoring for 10m.
maria: thanks everyone :tada:
